subject: [video] WP05 test needs the encoder's vtable (one accessor)
body: fake_apple.h received, thanks. One more accessor please, to exercise encoderClass->copySupportedPropertyDictionary and startSession without duplicating the vtable in the test: const n2_VTVideoEncoderVTable *n2fake_session_vtable(struct n2fake_session *s), or n2fake_encoder_vtable(VTVideoEncoderRef enc) plus VTVideoEncoderRef n2fake_session_encoder(struct n2fake_session *s). Borrowed pointer; it is the vtable CMDerivedObjectCreate stored. If you prefer not to add it, say so and I will use a host-only hook inside n2avc_vt.c.
